title: Penmanshiel wind farm: a physics-informed power curve and analytical wakes against public SCADA
description: One turbine's power curve and a whole farm's wakes on the Penmanshiel dataset (14 Senvion MM82, CC-BY-4.0, doi:10.5281/zenodo.16807304). A physics-informed monotone model with hard physical constraints is scored against the IEC binned curve, a logistic fit, boosted trees and the operator's own potential-power column on a later temporal window; the Jensen/PARK and Gaussian wake models are compared with the farm efficiency the SCADA implies, sector by sector, and their single decay constant is fitted on a validation window and scored on a test window.

metrics.name: physics_informed_rmse_kw
metrics.how: temporal holdout 2017-09-01..2017-12-31, turbine T01, 15964 operating 10-min samples, model fitted on 2016-06..2017-06 only

metrics.name: iec_binned_rmse_kw
metrics.how: same holdout and samples; IEC 61400-12-1 0.5 m/s binned curve fitted on the training window

metrics.name: gradient_boosted_rmse_kw
metrics.how: same holdout and samples; histogram gradient-boosted trees over wind speed, density ratio, temperature, direction sin/cos and anemometer spread

metrics.name: operator_potential_power_rmse_kw
metrics.how: same holdout and samples; the dataset's own 'Potential power default PC (kW)' column, a measured reference rather than a fitted model

metrics.name: physics_informed_energy_error_fraction
metrics.how: sum(predicted - measured) / sum(measured) over the same holdout

metrics.name: conformal_coverage_90
metrics.how: split-conformal half-width (80.0 kW) from the validation window, empirical coverage of the test residuals against a 0.90 target

metrics.name: wake_model_bias_textbook
metrics.how: Gaussian wake model with k*=0.0324555 minus SCADA-observed farm efficiency, mean over 96 sector x speed cells on the test window

metrics.name: wake_model_rmse_textbook
metrics.how: same 96 cells, root mean square of the efficiency difference

metrics.name: wake_model_rmse_calibrated
metrics.how: same 96 cells, with the decay constant fitted on the validation window (k*=0.090) and not on the test window

metrics.name: wake_model_direction_correlation
metrics.how: Pearson correlation between modelled and observed efficiency across the 96 cells; reported to show that the direction shape is NOT reproduced

metrics.name: farm_surrogate_r2
metrics.how: MLP fitted to the analytical farm model on a 36-direction grid and scored on a 54-direction grid at shifted wind speeds

checks.name: physics_informed_hard_constraints
checks.how: physical_guardrails re-measures cap, monotonicity, operating window and Betz on the fitted curve: all four pass, and the binned curve and both boosted-tree models fail three of the four

checks.name: temporal_split
checks.how: train 2016-06..2017-06, validation 2017-07..2017-08, test 2017-09..2017-12; no shuffled split, no lagged target, density and curve fits on train only

checks.name: domain_of_validity
checks.how: domain_report: 100 % of the test window lies inside the joint training envelope, i.e. this holdout is an interpolation test and is reported as such

checks.name: curtailment_model
checks.how: the curtailment study reports zero modelled gain at 4.2-5.2 D spacing after farm_power was fixed to scale the derated machine's own power with its thrust coefficient; before the fix it reported a 10-16 % gain that was an artefact
